headline: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Raises Benchmark Rate by 50 Basis Points
summary: The Philippine central bank hiked its key policy rate by 50 basis points, its first half-point move in nearly four years, citing broadening inflation risks from persistent supply shocks and El Niño.
why: The BSP sets monetary policy for the Philippines, balancing inflation containment against emerging-market economic expansion.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Higher rates aim to stabilize price growth but raise debt servicing costs for businesses and households.
